name: University of Huddersfield
description:
The University of Huddersfield is a university located in West Yorkshire, Huddersfield, England. 

Since 1992, it has been a university, but it originated in a series of institutions from the 19th century.

The university comprises 7 scholastic schools, and is located in the heart of Huddersfield, alongside the picturesque narrow canal. Huddersfield is a historic market town in West Yorkshire, 310 km north of London.

What is the University of Huddersfield acceptance rate for International Students?

The University of Huddersfield acceptance rate is 77%.

The University of Huddersfield library provides electronic resources, study spaces, journals, books and other reference materials to students in a spacious and studious environment. Huddersfield University provides academic support services such as tutoring, workshops and resources for improving study skills. The official QS University ranking system rates the university facilities as 5 stars.

Student Life

The everyday experience of students at the University of Huddersfield is fun and inclusive of all cultures. Over 60 global societies are active in representing the 3,300 international students enrolled on University courses via events such as the Lunar New Year and Global Week. There are 12 food outlets on campus and an app called â€˜Huddersfoodâ€™ for students to ensure their dietary preferences are catered to and they can find food while on the go! Global Week occurs every February to provide a range of sport tournaments, food festivals, film festivals, cultural events and workshops that represent different cultures and countries.

highlights.title: Overview
highlights.value: At the University of Huddersfield, you’ll be joining an institution that blends academic excellence with real-world experience. Whether you’re pursuing a degree in business, engineering, health, or creative arts, you’ll be part of an institution recognised for its outstanding teaching and innovative research. In 2022, the university was awarded Teaching Excellence Framework (TEF) Gold—the highest rating for the quality of teaching and learning.

highlights.title: Student Life
highlights.value: You’ll find a welcoming and energetic student community at Huddersfield, with students from over 100 countries. The Students’ Union creates a lively atmosphere, offering you everything from career workshops to fun social nights. The university also offers a comprehensive Wellness Program to support your physical, mental, and emotional health through mental health workshops and counselling services.

highlights.title: Accommodation
highlights.value:
The University of Huddersfield offers accommodation through HudLets, the accommodation service approved by the university. HudLets is run by the Huddersfield Students’ Union and works as a lettings agency. It provides you with various options, from single rooms to shared houses.

Additionally, if you’re looking for budget-friendly accommodation options outside the campus, feel free to download our app and check out the Stays feature!

highlights.title: Facilities
highlights.value:
Library
The University Library is your go-to space for study. It’s open 24/7 during key times in the year and offers you a mix of quiet zones and collaborative spaces. You'll also have access to thousands of online journals, e-books, and databases to support your coursework and research.

Sports
The University’s Sports Centre offers you top-class fitness facilities, including a fully equipped gym, exercise studios, and sports halls. If you want to compete, you can join one of the many student sports teams or participate in Campus Sport leagues.

Laboratory
You’ll also benefit from access to the university’s cutting-edge laboratories and specialised facilities. From advanced engineering labs to biological science and computing suites, you’ll find everything you need for your studies.

Cafeteria
You’ll have plenty of dining options in the cafeterias on campus. From hot meals and grab-and-go snacks, you’ll always have something to refuel yourself.
